arxiv-2107-05581.title: 21cmVAE : A Very Accurate Emulator of the 21-cm Global Signal Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2107-05581.creator: Christian H. Bye, Stephen K. N. Portillo, Anastasia Fialkov
arxiv-2107-05581.description: Abstract Considerable observational efforts are being dedicated to measuring the sky-averaged (global) 21-cm signal of neutral hydrogen from Cosmic Dawn and the Epoch of Reionization. Deriving observational constraints on the astrophysics of this era requires modeling tools that can quickly and accurately generate theoretical signals across the wide astrophysical parameter space.

arxiv-2204-00591.title: Cauchy Slice Holography: A New AdS/CFT Dictionary
arxiv-2204-00591.creator: Goncalo Araujo-Regado , Rifath Khan , Aron C. Wall
arxiv-2204-00591.description: Abstract We investigate a new approach to holography in asymptotically AdS spacetimes, in which time rather than space is the emergent dimension. By making a sufficiently large T 2 T^{2} -deformation of a Euclidean CFT, we define a holographic theory that lives on Cauchy slices of the Lorentzian bulk.

arxiv-2205-03344.title: Shortcomings of Class-level Documentation: A Survey
arxiv-2205-03344.creator: Jianwei Wu, Jining Yu, David Shepherd, James Clause
arxiv-2205-03344.description: Abstract To better understand the shortcomings of class-level documentation we conducted a survey of 167 experienced software developers recruited from from ABB, Inc., udel ( udel ), and popular, on-line programming forums (e.g., the programming subreddit 1 1 1 https://www.reddit.com/r/programming/ ).

arxiv-2210-07485.title: Holistic Sentence Embeddings for Better Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2210-07485.creator: Sishuo Chen, Xiaohan Bi, Rundong Gao, Xu Sun
arxiv-2210-07485.description: Abstract Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) instances is significant for the safe deployment of NLP models. Among recent textual OOD detection works based on pretrained language models (PLMs), distance-based methods have shown superior performance. However, they estimate sample distance scores in the last-layer CLS embedding space and thus do not make full use of linguistic information underlying in PLMs.

arxiv-2304-10780.title: Omni-Line-of-Sight Imaging for Holistic Shape Reconstruction
arxiv-2304-10780.creator: Binbin Huang, Xingyue Peng, Siyuan Shen, Suan Xia, Ruiqian Li, Yanhua Yu, Yuehan Wang Shenghua Gao, Wenzheng Chen, Shiying Li, and Jingyi Yu
arxiv-2304-10780.description: Abstract We introduce Omni-LOS, a neural computational imaging method for conducting holistic shape reconstruction (HSR) of complex objects utilizing a Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD)-based time-of-flight sensor. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , our method enables new capabilities to reconstruct near- 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} surrounding geometry of an object from a single scan spot.

arxiv-2306-04048.title: Finite Element Modeling of Pneumatic Bending Actuators for Inflated-Beam Robots PubID: pubid: 10.1109/LRA.2023.3320010 © 2023 IEEE ]
arxiv-2306-04048.creator: Cosima du Pasquier, Sehui Jeong, and Allison M. Okamura
arxiv-2306-04048.description: Abstract Inflated-beam soft robots, such as tip-everting vine robots, can control curvature by contracting one beam side via pneumatic actuation. This work develops a general finite element modeling approach to characterize their bending. The model is validated across four pneumatic actuator types (series, compression, embedded, and fabric pneumatic artificial muscles), and can be extended to other designs.

arxiv-2401-03830.title: A foundation for exact binarized morphological neural networks
arxiv-2401-03830.creator: Theodore Aouad, Hugues Talbot
arxiv-2401-03830.description: Abstract Training and running deep neural networks (NNs) often demands a lot of computation and energy-intensive specialized hardware (e.g. GPU, TPU…). One way to reduce the computation and power cost is to use binary weight NNs, but these are hard to train because the sign function has a non-smooth gradient.

M.S. thanks the Institute for
arxiv-2503-00959.creator: David Loeffler, Michael Stoll
arxiv-2503-00959.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Loeffler, Michael Stoll. The Riemann zeta function, and more generally the L L -functions of Dirichlet characters, are among the central objects of study in analytic number theory. We report on a project to formalize the theory of these objects in Lean’s ‘Mathlib’ library, including a proof of Dirichlet’s theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions and a formal statement of the Riemann hypothesis.

arxiv-2504-14845.title: Enhancing the Patent Matching Capability of Large Language Models via the Memory Graph
arxiv-2504-14845.creator: Qiushi Xiong, Zhipeng Xu, Zhenghao Liu, Mengjia Wang, Zulong Chen, Yue Sun, Yu Gu, Xiaohua Li, Ge Yu
arxiv-2504-14845.description: Abstract . Intellectual Property (IP) management involves strategically protecting and utilizing intellectual assets to enhance organizational innovation, competitiveness, and value creation. Patent matching is a crucial task in intellectual property management, which facilitates the organization and utilization of patents. Existing models often rely on the emergent capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and leverage them to identify related patents directly.

arxiv-2508-07683.title: TAR-TVG: Enhancing VLMs with Timestamp Anchor-Constrained Reasoning for Temporal Video Grounding
arxiv-2508-07683.creator: Chaohong Guo, Xun Mo, Yongwei Nie, Xuemiao Xu, Chao Xu, Fei Yu, Chengjiang Long
arxiv-2508-07683.description: Abstract Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) aims to precisely localize video segments corresponding to natural language queries, which is a critical capability for long-form video understanding. Although existing reinforcement learning approaches encourage models to generate reasoning chains before predictions, they fail to explicitly constrain the reasoning process to ensure the quality of the final temporal predictions.

arxiv-2508-18023.title: Beyond Traditional Quantum Routing
arxiv-2508-18023.creator: Si-Yi Chen, Angela Sara Cacciapuoti, Marcello Caleffi
arxiv-2508-18023.description: Abstract Existing quantum routing implicitly mimics classical routing principles, with finding the “best” path (aka pathfinding), according to a selected routing metric, as a core mechanism for establishing end-to-end entanglement. However, optimal pathfinding is computationally intensive, particularly in complex topologies.

europmc-pmc2923151.description: During social interaction, both participants are continuously active, each modifying their own actions in response to the continuously changing actions of the partner. This continuous mutual adaptation results in interactional synchrony to which both members contribute. Freely...

pmc-10651881.title: Optimal tracking control of the coal mining face fluid supply system via adaptive dynamic programming
pmc-10651881.creator: Xiaoteng Zeng, Dalong Wang
pmc-10651881.description: Emulsion pump station is widely used to provide power for full-mechanized coal mining face equipment. With the development of the mining technique of longwall face and the extensive use of large mining height and high working resistance of the hydraulic support, the fluid supply pressure is more unstable and the pressure impact is increasingly intensified.

pmc-10660364.title: Elevated expression of Axin2 in intestinal metaplasia and gastric cancers
pmc-10660364.creator: Dong Hui Lee, In Ho Jeong, Bogun Jang
pmc-10660364.description: BackgroundThe Wnt signaling pathway regulates crucial cellular processes, including stem cell development and tissue repair. Dysregulation of this pathway, particularly β-catenin stabilization, is linked to colorectal carcinoma and other tumors. Axin2, a critical component in the pathway, plays a role in β-catenin regulation. This study examines Axin2 expression in normal gastric mucosa and various gastric pathologies.

pmc-11505004.title: Expectancy Violations and Discontinuance Behavior in Live-Streaming Commerce: Exploring Human Interactions with Virtual Streamers
pmc-11505004.creator: Yanhong Chen, Xiangxia Li, Minseong Kim
pmc-11505004.description: Virtual streamers, as a typical application of AI-enabled digital humans, are increasingly being utilized in live-streaming commerce due to technological advancements and industry innovations. Although virtual streamers present several benefits, there is potential for adverse effects when they do not align with consumer expectations.

pmc-11629674.title: Association Between the Trajectories of the Atherogenic Index of Plasma and Prediabetes Progression to Diabetes: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11629674.creator: XiXuan Cai, MingYing Xu, JieRu Chen, YueChun Mao, JingYu Hu, LuSha Li, JianJiang Pan, MengQi Jin, LiYing Chen
pmc-11629674.description: PurposeThis study aims to analyze baseline profiles and longitudinal changes in Atherogenic Index of Plasma (AIP) among individuals with prediabetes to identify distinct AIP trajectories and assess their significance in predicting diabetes onset.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study analyzed data from 8346 participants who underwent multiple general health checks.

pmc-11677567.description: Background/Objectives: Functional probiotics, particularly Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. lactis CKDB001, have shown potential as a therapeutic option for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). However, their effects have not been confirmed in in vivo systems. Here, we investigated the effects of L. delbrueckii subsp.

pmc-13178680.title: Refining the biomanufacturing of microalgae-derived extracellular vesicles as a potential nanotherapeutic for osteoarthritis
pmc-13178680.creator: Meng Wang, Sara Gil Izquierdo, Aylin Kara Özenler, Jaqueline Lourdes Rios, Mylène de Ruijter, Debby Gawlitta, Jos Malda, Kenny Man
pmc-13178680.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative joint disease characterized by oxidative stress, chronic inflammation and progressive cartilage degradation. Current treatments remain largely symptomatic and fail to target underlying disease mechanisms. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as promising nanotherapeutics; however, mammalian-derived EVs face limitations related to cost, scalability and manufacturing complexity.

pmc-13342438.title: First high-density linkage map based on GBS derived genome wide SNP markers in Labeo catla (Hamilton, 1822)
pmc-13342438.creator: Bismay Sahoo, Priyanka Nandanpawar, Gargee Das, Nirjharini Priyadarshini, Lakshman Sahoo, Jitendra Kumar Sundaray, Paramananda Das
pmc-13342438.description: Labeo catla is a commercially important Indian Major Carp, yet its genetic improvement has been hindered by a lack of high-resolution genomic resources. We report the construction of the first high-density SNP-based genetic linkage map for this species and present the associated genomic datasets deposited in public repositories.
